profile_text.body:
Kyndryl is a public company, founded in 2021 and headquartered in New York, NY, USA, that trades under the ticker KD. On its own site the company says it designs, builds, manages and modernizes the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day.

Its site addresses AI mainly through research and commentary rather than named products. Kyndryl's 2026 People Readiness Report, described on the site, reports a decline in workforce readiness as AI adoption surges, and the company says the report explores why workforce readiness has become one of the most important factors determining AI success. The site also states that AI-native enterprises create the conditions for continuous growth, efficiency and resilience by putting AI at the core of their business, and it hosts an episode of The Innovation Show x The Kyndryl Institute podcast in which five leaders discuss how AI is evolving current business models. A further item on the site says that as geopolitical tensions escalate and AI accelerates attackers' capabilities, organizations must rethink what resilience looks like in the context of prosperity, security, and public trust.

The company's profile lists a CIK of 0001867072, and its recorded law exposure is in New York, with a count of 459. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are recorded for it.
